name: Hollow Deathscyther
description: A grim harbinger of the stadium. Hollow Deathscyther utilizes a heavily off-center, asymmetrical single-scythe design visible in 14037.png to deliver unbalance-inducing strikes that destabilize the opponent's spin axis with surgical precision.

ability.name: Soul Hunt
ability.description: Each Attack win steals 0.5 Stamina from the enemy and heals 25 HP. Every 3 successful hunts: +25 ATK for 3 turns and apply 2 Burn stacks (15 dmg/stack/turn for 3 turns). If the stamina steal empties the enemy's stamina pool, Hollow Deathscyther executes them for 45 true damage.

special_move.name: Grim Quake
special_move.description: Channels all rotational weight into a singular, devastating off-center slash that shatters the opponent's spin axis!
